about.title: About
about.body: I'm Abdalrhman, a front-end developer specializing in React and TypeScript. I've built interfaces for platforms serving hospitals, shops and schools, and a tool that turns a system description into requirements and diagrams using AI. My working knowledge of the backend (Node.js and databases) helps me see the whole picture. I care about the details: proper RTL, performance and accessibility.
